Name: Kenneth's Battle Blades
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Battle Blades[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]12 battle blades for Kenneth's Weapon Shop. A mix of rusty iron, classic steel, and fire and ice looks, good for everyday mine runs[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]12 blades in Shop4, all with that battle-ready feel. Some are small and fast, some are steady for everyday use, and some are heavy and hit hard. Daggers, short swords, classic blades, and big broad blades are in there, with a few fire, ice, and lightning looks mixed in[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Shop4 in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Weapon Shop - Shop4[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Each blade is sold once a day. You buy it with gold plus bars / gems, so bring both when you stop by[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Weapon Shop, Shop4[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Weapon Shop - you need this so Shop4 shows up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Weapon Shop is also installed[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop4[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other swords from Kenneth's Weapon Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
